scripts.bootstrap: sh -c 'if ! command -v pnpm >/dev/null 2>&1; then if ! command -v corepack >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "corepack is required to activate pnpm@10.33.0" >&2; exit 1; fi; corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@10.33.0 --activate; fi; pnpm install'
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter @rop/kds-web test:e2e && pnpm --filter @rop/backoffice-web test:e2e && pnpm --filter @rop/crew-web test:e2e
scripts.db:generate: pnpm --filter @rop/db-kds generate && pnpm --filter @rop/db-auth generate && pnpm --filter @rop/db-inventory generate && pnpm --filter @rop/db-crm generate
scripts.db:migrate:deploy: pnpm --filter @rop/db-kds exec prisma migrate deploy --schema ./prisma/schema.prisma && pnpm --filter @rop/db-auth exec prisma migrate deploy --schema ./prisma/schema.prisma && pnpm --filter @rop/db-inventory exec prisma migrate deploy --schema ./prisma/schema.prisma
